notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S148 (electric vehicle charging; for rapid charging facilities of at least 50 kW urban / 75 kW rural). Traced from the full page render (the E V lettering is not in the sheet's filled artwork). Layout: 350 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol white panel with E V cut out in blue (100 D) and a charging cable with plug (281 x 277) x 35-315 y 37-314.
